stemMd: The donor attached no conditions of any kind to the grant and imposed no limits on how the funds could be used; the support was ______.
instructionsMd: Select the TWO choices that complete the sentence coherently and give it equivalent meanings.
explanationMd: Both unrestricted and unconditional fit support with neither usage limits nor any other conditions. Qualified and contingent imply conditions, while anonymous and meagre concern different properties.

distractorRationale.a: The donor's identity is not addressed.
